description: Land Title Settlement Department - Wewathenna, Four Gravets Kandy and Gangawata Korale D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320385 (22/0804)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels, including detailed information about land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, and property rights. The content focuses on land registration and title settlement processes, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it primarily concerns land and property-related administrative matters.
